name: chime-sdk-meetings
description: The Amazon Chime SDK meetings APIs in this section allow software developers to create Amazon Chime SDK meetings, set the Amazon Web Services Regions for meetings, create and manage users, and send and receive meeting notifications.

subcommands.name: batch-create-attendee
subcommands.description: Creates up to 100 attendees for an active Amazon Chime SDK meeting.

subcommands.name: batch-update-attendee-capabilities-except
subcommands.description: Updates AttendeeCapabilities except the capabilities listed in an ExcludedAttendeeIds table.

subcommands.name: create-attendee
subcommands.description: Creates a new attendee for an active Amazon Chime SDK meeting.

subcommands.name: create-meeting
subcommands.description: Creates a new Amazon Chime SDK meeting in the specified media Region with no initial attendees.

subcommands.name: create-meeting-with-attendees
subcommands.description: Creates a new Amazon Chime SDK meeting in the specified media Region, with attendees.

subcommands.name: delete-attendee
subcommands.description: Deletes an attendee from the specified Amazon Chime SDK meeting and deletes their JoinToken.

subcommands.name: delete-meeting
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified Amazon Chime SDK meeting.

subcommands.name: get-attendee
subcommands.description: Gets the Amazon Chime SDK attendee details for a specified meeting ID and attendee ID.

subcommands.name: get-meeting
subcommands.description: Gets the Amazon Chime SDK meeting details for the specified meeting ID.

subcommands.name: list-attendees
subcommands.description: Lists the attendees for the specified Amazon Chime SDK meeting.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the tags available for the specified resource.

subcommands.name: start-meeting-transcription
subcommands.description: Starts transcription for the specified meetingId.

subcommands.name: stop-meeting-transcription
subcommands.description: Stops transcription for the specified meetingId.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes the specified tags from the specified resources.

subcommands.name: update-attendee-capabilities
subcommands.description: The capabilities that you want to update.
